name: coworkingview
description: Search private offices, managed and serviced offices, coworking spaces, desks and meeting rooms worldwide, with prices, amenities and locations.

interface.longDescription: CoworkingView lets you search a catalogue of office and workspace options: private offices, managed and serviced offices, coworking spaces, hot and dedicated desks, meeting rooms, day passes, virtual offices and event spaces. Look up a city or district, filter by workspace type and amenities, compare listings side by side, see typical market prices per city, and read details about a specific space or operator. Results link back to the listing on coworkingview.com. The tool is read-only: it cannot book a space, contact an operator or change any data. Prices are shown in the currency and billing period published by each operator and may change.
defaultPrompt: Compare serviced office prices in Madrid.
What does a hot desk cost in London?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns several Berlin coworking spaces with prices and links to coworkingview.com.

positive.prompt: What does a hot desk cost in London?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns typical hot desk price statistics for London in the published currency and billing period.

positive.prompt: Compare the top two coworking spaces in Madrid.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a side-by-side comparison of two Madrid listings without inventing data.

positive.prompt: What are the best coworking spaces in Barcelona?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an ordered list of Barcelona spaces with links, without printing a numeric score.

positive.prompt: Which amenities can I filter coworking spaces by?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the live amenities and workspace types available as filters.

negative.prompt: Book a desk at a Berlin coworking space for tomorrow.
Write me a poem about the sea.
Delete the listing of a coworking space from your catalogue.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only search, comparison and market prices for coworking spaces.
